name: easy-escola-monorepo
description: Easy Escola - Plataforma Educacional Multi-tenant (frontend + backend)

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm -w backend run dev" "npm -w frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm -w backend run build && npm -w frontend run build
scripts.lint: npm -w backend run lint && npm -w frontend run lint
scripts.test: npm -w backend run test && npm -w frontend run test
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm -w backend run start" "npm -w frontend run preview"
